scope_note: Dependency resolution and upstream qualification only. This file records resolved pins and observed evidence; it does not claim upstream behavior beyond what was executed. Regenerate via the named commands when changing any pin; do not edit go.mod pins independently of this report. Revision 2 (P02, implementation-remediation) reconciled this report against the actual source tree after revision 1 left a stale forward-looking claim in qualified_features: fyne.io/fyne/v2 was removed from go.mod/go.sum on 2026-09-19 (fdba444, following ADR 002's Flutter replacement of the native Go desktop six days earlier), but the prior revision still asserted 'Fyne v2.8.1 compiles and links' as though it were a current qualified feature. That claim is moved to historical_evidence below, clearly labeled as a fact about a build that no longer exists in the module graph, not a current qualification. No fyne import remains anywhere in Go source; the only surviving string 'fyne' is packaging/desktop_test.go asserting the framework is rejected as capability_unsupported. Revision 3 refreshes the public Serenity inspection to b4febdf7 after upstream changed; it records observed narrow improvements while preserving the full first-chat hard gate. Rev10 native Mac package/CI code is implementation in progress, not release qualification.

historical_evidence.removal_reason: ADR 002 (2026-09-13 in spirit, decided 2026-09-15/18) replaced the native Go desktop with the Flutter client at apps/desktop, retiring internal/desktop and cmd/zatiti-desktop. Fyne was only still required because the root anchor file tools_deps.go held it behind a build tag; once cobra, the MCP Go SDK and modernc.org/sqlite had real package imports, go mod tidy dropped the anchor and Fyne with it, along with its transitive testify, go-spew, go-difflib and yaml.v3.
historical_evidence.historical_note: Prior to removal, Fyne v2.8.1 compiled and linked via cgo on darwin/amd64 under the then-pinned toolchain. This is a historical fact about a build configuration that no longer exists; it is NOT a current qualification claim, the module is not in go.mod/go.sum, and nothing in this repository imports it. Do not cite this entry as evidence that any current desktop framework claim is qualified.

external_services.resolution: Public HEAD now includes durable remember.operation_key keyed replay/conflict, cancel_memory_operation fencing, exact read_memory_fact by its 64-hex id, a cooperative serve writer lock, and named Keychain credential profiles. Source tests for internal/server/memory, internal/server/mcp, and internal/writer passed in the inspected clone; no live Zatiti-to-Serenity service call occurred. Full Zatiti dispatch remains blocked: MCP session handshake still violates one Invoke/one physical request, no authoritative read-only status lookup by command key exists, claim identity/version/confidence/freshness and revision reports are insufficient, and per-call cost/destination bounds and running-commit attestation are not established. Adapter tests verify fail-closed behavior only. Required to lift: qualified public protocol coverage for every row and real-service tests/observed evidence in tests/qualification; partial upstream improvements are not a reduced release gate.
